thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks fall, led by Caterpillar and Boeing - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks fall, led by Caterpillar and Boeing - MarketWatch
text:
Published: Mar 7, 2018 8:14 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor 
Shares of all 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.44% components fell in premarket trade Wednesday, led by selloffs in Caterpillar Inc.'s CAT, -1.37% and Boeing Co.'s BA, -0.57% stocks, as the resignation of Gary Cohn cast a pall on the broader market . Dow futures YMH8, -0.70% slumped 268 points. Shares of Caterpillar shed 2.2%, and were on track to shave about 24 points off the Dow's price, while Boeing's stock lost 1.8% to put it on track to shave about 44 points off the Dow. The most-active stocks were Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.69% which shed 0.9%, and Intel Corp.'s INTC, +1.31% which lost 1.1%. The best performer was Coca-Cola Co. shares KO, -0.25% which were down just 0.6%.
